subject: Charter Review Commission Proposal
overview: The council debated a home rule petition to establish a charter commission and addressed school security concerns following a recent bomb threat. They also discussed the historical preservation of 21 Touro Avenue and various municipal infrastructure updates.

items.title: Condolences and Dedication
items.summary: Approved a resolution of sympathy for the family of former Deputy Mayor Robert Drennan and voted to dedicate the meeting in his memory.

items.title: Preservation of 21 Touro Avenue
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting Tufts University place a deed restriction on the historic property to prevent subdivision and seeking an update on preservation efforts from the Historic District Commission.

items.title: Salem Street Parking Lot Lighting
items.summary: Approved a request to install lights in the Medford Square business parking lot on Salem Street.

items.title: Charter Commission Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Referred a proposal to bypass signature requirements for a city charter commission to the Committee of the Whole and scheduled a public hearing for the following week.

items.title: School Notification Policy
items.summary: Approved a request for the school department to forward its written emergency notification policy for principals to the council.

items.title: High School Security Camera Report
items.summary: Approved a request for a detailed report identifying broken security cameras at Medford High School and a timeline for their repair.

items.title: Emergency Sweep Personnel and Training
items.summary: Approved a request for information regarding the training and job titles of personnel tasked with sweeping the high school following a bomb threat.

items.title: Forest Street Crosswalk Update
items.summary: Requested an update on the status of a proposed crosswalk on Forest Street between King and Cedar to provide safe access to McNally Park.

items.title: 56 Boynton Road Probate Status
items.summary: Requested a status update from the administration regarding the probate litigation for the abandoned property at 56 Boynton Road.

items.title: Library Roof Repairs and Director Search
items.summary: Requested that the administration repair the leaking library roof immediately and provided an update on the search for a new library director.

items.title: Routine Condolences and MassDOT Project Update
items.summary: Approved condolences for the Puccio family and requested a point person for the ongoing MassDOT bridge project.
